Container.Name: nas-mcp
Container.Overview: Read-only MCP server for this Unraid NAS. It joins your Tailscale tailnet as hostname nas-mcp and is not published on LAN ports or the public internet. Do not add port mappings. Follow docs/unraid-setup.md: make the GHCR package public, create a tagged auth key, generate MCP_AUTH_TOKEN, then apply.
Container.Description: Read-only MCP server for this Unraid NAS, reachable only on your Tailscale tailnet. No host ports. See docs/unraid-setup.md.
Container.Requires: Public GHCR image ghcr.io/ferrisweil/nas-mcp:latest. Tailscale auth key tagged tag:nas-mcp. Do not map host ports. /dev/net/tun must exist on the Unraid host.

Config.Name: MCP Auth Token
Config.Description: Bearer token required on every MCP request. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Tailscale Auth Key
Config.Description: Reusable, non-ephemeral Tailscale auth key tagged tag:nas-mcp. Create at https://login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/keys

Config.Name: Tailscale Hostname
Config.Description: MagicDNS name advertised on the tailnet

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone matching Unraid Settings → Date and Time, e.g. America/Chicago

Config.Name: Appdata (Tailscale state)
Config.Description: Must persist so the node stays logged in across container updates. Keep this on the array/cache, not the USB flash drive.

Config.Name: User shares (read-only)
Config.Description: Unraid user shares, bind-mounted read-only for get_disk_usage

Config.Name: TUN device
Config.Description: Required for Tailscale kernel networking so port 8787 is reachable on the tailnet IP

Config.Name: Listen address
Config.Description: 0.0.0.0 exposes the MCP port on the tailnet. No host ports are published.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Container listen port. Do not add a Unraid port mapping for this.

Config.Name: Disk paths
Config.Description: Comma-separated paths inside the container reported by get_disk_usage

Config.Name: MCP hostname allowlist
Config.Description: Allowed HTTP Host name in addition to *.ts.net and Tailscale IPs

Config.Name: Tailscale extra args
Config.Description: Passed to tailscale up. Keep the nas-mcp tag unless you changed the ACL.

Config.Name: Tailscale Serve
Config.Description: If true, also serve HTTPS on tailnet :443 (Serve, not Funnel). Needs MagicDNS + HTTPS certificates.

Config.Name: Tailscale userspace
Config.Description: Set true only if /dev/net/tun cannot be used. Then bind 127.0.0.1 and rely on Serve for inbound access.
